description: Season-aware conference-membership windows per programme (institution_slug x gender), 2016-2026. Authored from official GAC/MIAA, LSC, GSC, GLVC, RMAC, SSC, NE10, CACC, ECC, PSAC, MEC, G-MAC, GLIAC (gliac.org), SAC (the thesac.com standings archive), Conference Carolinas (conferencecarolinas.com), Peach Belt (peachbeltconference.org), CCAA (goccaa.org), PacWest (thepacwest.com) and GNAC (the gnacsports.com standings archive) and NSIC (northernsun.org) records, and for NCAA Division I men's soccer 2022-2026 (the 25 conferences whose conference_profiles carry level d1, the Mid-American Conference for 2022 only) from each conference's own records pages and 2026 standings, each 2022 season also held against the conference's archived 2022 standings (standings.aspx?standings={id}, the id named in the source sentence), the Big East and CAA standings archives for divisions, and the researched pages the season matrix names for the WAC, the 2022 and 2023 Pac-12 and the movers (Wayback captures where the conference's own archive no longer serves the season); each window cites its source. standings_archives names, per conference code, the standings archive a conference with no per-season records pages keeps its member lists in (url_template with {id}, and the page id per season), so a source sentence can cite the page and check-membership --standings can read a captured copy of it back. Sibling in role to the generated canon.json identity map - identity and membership are separate axes (tl-ath plan gate, 2026-08-08).

men.source: Auburn Montgomery Warhawks, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auburn_Montgomery_Warhawks (accessed 2026-08-20): AUM was approved for the NCAA Division II membership process on 2015-07-17 and "began the transition with the 2015-16 season, while joining the Gulf South Conference for all sports effective in the 2017-18 season." The window therefore opens at 2017. This corrects an earlier reading of the conference statistics pages (https://gscsports.org/stats.aspx?path=msoc&year=2018&conf=true), which appeared to show AUM first joining in 2019: those pages omit schools still inside the D2 provisional period, which compete on a full conference schedule without counting toward conference statistics. Nine distinct GSC member sites independently published AUM as a conference opponent in each of 2017 and 2018 — a full round-robin slate in both seasons.
